background: JPMorgan Chase & Co. is the holding company of the largest US bank, spanning consumer and community banking, the corporate and investment bank, commercial banking and asset and wealth management.
synthesis: JPMorgan Chase is rated A+ on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at A, all three on a stable outlook; the last move was a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 15 Nov 2024. The only ratio shown is leverage, at 7.5% in the top quarter of US banks, so capital looks strong on that measure while risk-weighted capital and liquidity are not covered here. The flagged news concerns job cuts and a debanking lawsuit rather than the balance sheet, the newest on 21 Aug 2026.
